description: 행정안전부_생활안전지도 도로시설(횡단보도, WMS) [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 행정안전부. 행정안전부에서 운영하는 생활안전지도 ( safemap. go. kr)에서 제공하는 도로시설(횡단보도) 정보로 국토지리정보원의 횡단보도 레이어 정보를 수집한 것으로 생활안전지도. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 행정안전부. Its tags are 도로, 교통, 시설, 횡단보도, 위치정보. It offers 1 resource(s) in wms. The portal shows 2025-11-19 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
